messages:
lex_sales: Hi team — passing Glyder Health (Dedicated 3-node, private/VPC) to CS. Key asks: Azure AD SSO, HSM/KMS proof of separation, and a small offline eval dataset to load into pre-prod. Target provisioning week: Apr 4 (customer in PST). Renewal in ~10 months; sales flags moderate risk due to regulatory/residency questions. Contacts: Amy (PO) amy@glyderhealth.com, Raj (CTO) raj@glyderhealth.com. Order: https://redwood.example.com/orders/ORD-5643.

sam_csm: Thanks @lex_sales — I'll be account lead. @anya_onboard can you run onboarding PM? I'll open a CS ticket and schedule kickoff.

anya_onboard: I can take onboarding. Need: SSO admin + tenant ID, preferred window for peering, exact network CIDR, and who will validate the eval dataset ingestion. Also any legal acceptance criteria for KMS. @lex_sales can you share tenant + short list of acceptance items?

lex_sales: Sent via secure channel: Tenant ID `tenant-0a1b2c3d`. Network CIDR suggested `10.2.0.0/16`. Amy is SSO admin. Legal wants our KMS integration doc and confirmation on HSM key separation; CFO asked about demo of key separation.

sam_csm: I created CS-3497 and attached the order and tenant info. Setting kickoff tentatively Wed Apr 6 10:00am PST. Marking renewal risk = "moderate" in CRM; adding a 90-day checkpoint to confirm SSO/KMS progress.

mike_eng: I'll take the HSM/KMS triage. Questions for customer: cert rotation policy, preferred KMS provider (Azure Key Vault / customer HSM / managed), and whether they require an HSM appliance in their VPC. I'll open ENG-7890 for tracking and do a short spike Mon Apr 4. Tagging @security and @infra.

taylor_support: Ops note — please add me to CS & ENG tickets. I'll prepare a post-onboard runbook and want to shadow the first deploy. Need on-call rotation and escalation steps clarified.

anya_onboard: Kickoff confirmed Wed Apr 6 10:00am PST with Amy & Raj. Owners: @sam_csm (CS lead), @anya_onboard (onboard PM), @mike_eng (eng triage), @taylor_support (ops). Next steps: 1) @lex_sales email SSO admin + provide signed order & legal KMS doc; 2) @sam_csm finalize CS-3497 and invite stakeholders; 3) @mike_eng open ENG-7890 and post initial findings; 4) @taylor_support draft runbook stub. I'll add these to the kickoff agenda.

lex_sales: Done — emailed Amy with the kickoff invite and CC'd Raj. Uploaded KMS request to legal and shared the order link. Placed the network CIDR in secure channel.

sam_csm: Noted. Adding a 30/60/90-day onboarding milestone plan to CS-3497. Will follow up after ENG-7890 spike to update provisioning ETA.

mike_eng: ENG-7890 created and linked to CS-3497. Spike scheduled Mon Apr 4. Early concern: if Glyder requires customer-managed HSM in their VPC, we may need extra infra work and a longer timeline. Will report blockers in ENG ticket.

taylor_support: Added to both tickets. I will share a runbook draft by Apr 5 and request shadowing slot Apr 6 after kickoff. Also will draft a quick escalation matrix to include SLOs and contact points.

lex_sales: FYI the customer also asked about data residency proof and an audit trail for access to keys. Legal is on it but flagged as potential renewal discussion topic.

sam_csm: Good to know — I'll log that under renewal risk notes and add a renewal touchpoint 60 days before term to surface any compliance concerns.

anya_onboard: Captured owners + actions in the kickoff doc. Please ping this thread for any changes to tenant or legal blockers. I'll post the kickoff agenda and link to CS-3497 shortly.

mike_eng: After the spike I may need a short architecture review session with Glyder's Raj to confirm HSM topology. If they want an on-prem HSM appliance, we'll need network details and provisioning lead time.

taylor_support: Also requesting that CS/ENG coordinate a joint smoke test plan for eval dataset ingestion so support can triage issues post-deploy.

sam_csm: Agreed — adding a smoke test checklist to CS-3497: SSO login, eval dataset upload, inference sanity checks, and key-access audit verification.

lex_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll monitor legal's KMS response and update here.

sam_csm: Closing loop for now — will update CS-3497 after kickoff. If anything changes on the customer side (tenant, CIDR, legal), please post here.
